notes: Settings me ab Alarms ka alag page hai — sab active alarms aik jagah nazar aayenge, har aik par Cancel. Language aur Text Size ab app ki theme wale dropdowns me khulte hain (koi system dialog nahi). Reports tab ka neeche wala khaali sabz hissa theek ho gaya hai. Alarm lagane ke liye exact-alarm ijazat zaroori hai (na ho to alarm set hi nahi hoga), notification ya location off ho to har bar popup batayega. Bus number #4, #3, #2, #1 jese saaf nazar aata hai. Reports, planner aur 1.9 wali behtariyan bhi shamil hain.
